summary: Phase 3 AI Calling Testing Mode (Test Candidate Management) tested end-to-end: backend pytest 17/17 pass (template xlsx/csv, preview categories, .txt/column-mismatch rejection, validate-rows, import rejection + success, list filters/search/pagination, manual create validation/409, approve last4+consent, edit-invalidates-approval with audit, bulk approve/revoke/delete confirmations, single delete 404 after, initiate 423 exact message, live 403, stop calls, emergency stop remains ACTIVE, ai_call_jobs=0/ai_calls=0, no Bolna requests in logs). UI flows all work: sample downloads, unchanged sample -> 2 example rows + import disabled, mixed CSV -> chips, cell edit -> re-validate -> exclude invalid -> re-validate -> import toast, .txt toast, manual add (HTML5 required + server invalid phone toast, 9000000260 normalized to +91), approve dialog, edit phone -> 'Approval was invalidated' toast + Needs approval, pagination 20/page, filters, bulk approve/revoke/delete, single delete, Call Selected/Call Now disabled, exact disabled message, Stop Calls toast. Regression routes all load. Found 3 UI state bugs (stale dialog state, pagination after delete).

minor.issue: Loads up to 5000 docs into memory and filters readiness in Python before paginating; fine for test volumes but silently caps at 5000.

ui_bugs.issue: consent/last4 state is never reset. After approving one candidate (or after an edit invalidates approval), reopening Approve shows consent checkbox ALREADY CHECKED and previous last4 (e.g. '0260') pre-filled. Weakens the explicit consent confirmation. Reset state when `candidate` changes (useEffect on candidate) or key the dialog by candidate.id.

consent and typed word persist between openings. Second Bulk approve opens with consent checked and 'APPROVE' already typed -> Confirm enabled immediately, defeating the typed-confirmation safeguard. Opening Delete after Approve shows 'APPROVE' in the box. Reset consent/word when `action` changes/opens. Also during close animation the title flips to 'Delete test candidates' because action becomes null.
After bulk deleting all rows while on page 2, UI shows 'Page 2 of 1' with empty list; q.page is not clamped/reset to 1 after delete (bulk or single) when the current page becomes empty.

design_issues.screen: Testing Mode manual form / edit dialog
issues: Interview date and time use native browser <input type=date/time> pickers instead of shadcn Calendar/Popover (inconsistent styling).
After excluding rows and re-validating, the 'Total' chip shows only included rows (Total 3, Excluded 4) — original file total is lost; consider 'Total 7 · Included 3'.

action_items: Reset ApproveDialog state (consent=false, last4='') whenever a new candidate is opened
Reset BulkConfirmDialog state (consent=false, word='') whenever the dialog opens / action changes; keep title stable during close animation
Reset/clamp q.page when the current page becomes empty after deletes (or use data.pages from response to clamp)
Optional: replace native date/time inputs with shadcn components
critical_code_review_comments: TestingMode.load keeps stale `selected` entries for deleted candidates (fresh[k] || v) — after single delete of a selected row it stays counted in 'N selected' and would be sent to bulk endpoints (backend tolerates via not_found).
Bulk revoke has no confirmation dialog (acceptable per spec, but inconsistent with bulk approve/delete).

Backend gating is solid: initiate always 423, live 403, import re-validates server side and rejects if any row invalid, approval requires last4 + consent and is invalidated on phone/name change with audit entry.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_* candidates with phones +9190000002xx (pytest + UI); all deleted by id. Final state: 6 original candidates untouched (2 approved), emergency_stop still ACTIVE, ai_call_jobs=0, ai_calls=0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_ai_calling_phase3.py -p no:randomly (tests are order-dependent within module; uses +9190000002xx phones and cleans up). Retest ApproveDialog/BulkConfirmDialog state reset and pagination after delete. Do not release emergency stop.
rca of the issue: Dialogs are always mounted (open controlled by prop) and their useState values are initialized once, so consent/word/last4 survive between openings. Pagination: q.page stays at old value after deletes; backend returns pages=1 but frontend doesn't clamp.
